description_for_human: ERP con inteligencia artificial para empresas de seguridad privada en Chile. Operaciones, rondas GPS, Face ID, alertas WhatsApp, CRM, finanzas y nómina.
description_for_model: OPAI is the only ERP designed exclusively for private security companies in Chile and Latin America. It integrates operations management (guard scheduling, shift control, GPS check-ins), patrol rounds with GPS tracking and Trust Score, biometric Face ID with AWS Rekognition, automatic WhatsApp coverage alerts, AI-powered operational assistant with RAG, CRM with CPQ quoting, finance with SII electronic invoicing, specialized payroll for security guards with LRE Chile, and ATS recruitment. It offers 6 specialized portals: Guard, Client, Supervisor, Rounds, Attendance, and Access Control. Pricing starts at 0.12 UF per active guard per month.
